description.value: Alliance Française Vancouver is a Francophone cultural centre serving the city since 1904, now housed in a new three-storey building in the Oakridge neighbourhood that opened in 2024. It hosts public cultural events including film screenings, theatre, concerts, art exhibitions, and book clubs, alongside a French-language library and a VR library. Conveniently accessible via the Canada Line (Oakridge–41st or Langara–49th stations), it offers a welcoming cultural stop for curious visitors.
